Name: Easy Access
Author: LeFauxMatt
TagLine: Provides easier access to producers in the game.
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png)
Provides easier access to producers in the game.

![](https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png)
Easy Access is safe to add/remove at any time. It should work with any machine, including ones added by Producer Framework Mod.

![](https://i.imgur.com/GPXxDLK.png)

*   **Collect Outputs** - Hit a configurable key to instantly collect items from nearby producers into your inventory.

*   **Dispense Inputs** - Hit a configurable key to instantly dispense eligible items from your inventory into nearby producers.
![](https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png)
For ease of use, it is recommended to set config options from [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098).

*   **CollectOutputDistance** - The distance in tiles that machines can be collected from.

*   **DispenseInputDistance** - The distance in tiles that machines can be dispensed into.

*   **DoDigSpots** - Whether or not CollectItems will collect from dig spots.

*   **DoForage** - Whether or not CollectItems will collect foraging like wild onions.

*   **DoMachines** - Whether or not CollectItems will collect from machines such as furnaces and kegs.

*   **DoTerrain** - Whether or not CollectItems will collect from terrain such as trees and bushes.
![](https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png)
See [here](https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/StardewMods/blob/develop/EasyAccess/README.md#translations) for the current status on translations.
